notes.title: Steam Deck and QoL update
notes.content:
Hi Crafters!

Today's update implements some features suggested by the community, and fixes some bugs.

Update 0.51:
- improved support for Steam Deck and Controllers.
- this free Prologue now includes some of the QoL features that were first introduced in the full Eden Crafters game.
- Fixed misc. bugs

The full game, Eden Crafters is now available on Early Access!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570210/Eden_Crafters/?curator_clanid=4777282

The Early Access version is packed with more than 70 hours of content and introduces some new planets for you to explore, terraform, and automate. We've added a ton of exciting new features and enhancements compared to the Ocean World prologue:

[list]
[*]     3 planets with unique challenges, and more planets will be added in the next few months
[*]     30 production and logistics machines, with 3 tiers of conveyors for advanced factory building
[*]     17 different resources and 58 crafting parts to discover and create
[*]     13 terraformation buildings to help you tackle the challenges of these new worlds
[*]     A lot of new base building elements
[*]     2 spaceships and 3 land vehicles, a tool to build roads
[*]     And much more!
[/list]


Thank you for your support and don't forget to join our Discord or post in the Steam community forums!

notes.title: Early Access is now available!
notes.content:
Hi Crafters!

Eden Crafters is now available in Early Access:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570210/Eden_Crafters/

This Early Access version is packed with more than 50 hours of content and introduces some new planets for you to explore, terraform, and automate. We've added a ton of exciting new features and enhancements compared to the Ocean World prologue:

[list]
[*] 28 production and logistics machines, with 3 tiers of conveyors for advanced factory building
[*] 17 different resources and 58 crafting parts to discover and create
[*] 12 terraformation buildings to help you tackle the challenges of these new worlds
[*] A lot of new base building elements
[*] 2 spaceships and 3 land vehicles, a tool to build roads
[*] And much more!
[/list]

[h2]New planet: Echo Prime[/h2]

Echo Prime is a huge 144 km2 planet, with a variety of challenges in different regions: blizzard, radioactive areas and toxic lakes will be a few of your obstacles while turning this planet into a new Eden.

[h2]Extended planet: Ocean World[/h2]

For those you played the Ocean World prologue, this planet is in the Early Access but with additionnal content including a big new island, if you want to continue your previous save you need to "enable demo saves" from the Options menu.
It also comes with a new Hardcore mode if you are looking for more challenge: in this mode, the giant tidal waves can destroy a lot of structures from your base.

[h2]Upcoming: Aetheria[/h2]

A third planet is currently being polished and will be added next month to Early Access.
After that, we plan to add additionnal planets during 2025.


We’ve got an exciting roadmap of free updates planned for the coming months, including:

[list]
    [*]Controllers support
    [*]Trains, offering a powerful alternative to conveyors
    [*]New terraforming vehicles
    [*]Custom ship creation to craft your own unique spaceships
    [*]Animal species
    [*]New planets and updates to existing ones, adding lore and story
[/list] 

All updates will be free if you own the Early Access version.
We can’t wait to hear your feedback during the Early Access phase as we continue to shape and improve Eden Crafters together. Your input has always been invaluable for our development process!

Thank you for your continued support, and don’t forget to join the conversation on our Discord or Steam community forums!

notes.title: Small Patch 0.23c
notes.content:
Hi Crafters!

With today's patch, we've updated the Steam networking framework used for Co-op mode. Previously, a few players were unable to connect with some of their friends. We hope this update resolves the issue for everyone. If you experience any problems while playing in Co-op mode, please let us know in the Steam discussions or on Discord.

Due to this change, make sure both you and your friends have the 0.23c update installed, as older versions are not compatible with this one.

This patch also adjusts the Spaceship controls. You can now choose between holding Left Click for precise, fully manual piloting with your mouse, or using WASD for semi-assisted piloting, where the ship’s altitude will automatically adjust to follow the terrain.

We're still working to find the most enjoyable way to navigate the Spaceship, so let us know what you think!


Thanks for your great feedback!

The full game will come in October, and you can wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570210/Eden_Crafters/

notes.title: Small Update 0.23
notes.content:
Hi Crafters!

Today's patch implements some features suggested by the community and fixes some bugs:
- You can now cut down trees
- Trees and Large Ore Deposits will now follow the terrain height when you terraform
- New item: Interior Stair (first create a Life Compartment on top of another one, then place the interior stair)
- You can now use middle-click (mouse-wheel) while looking at an item to add his recipe to the hotbar.
- Platforms placement made easier, snapping together with a previously placed platform
- Stairs placement made easier, in continuation of a previously placed Stair
- Updated Exterior Stair model to better snap multiple stairs together
- Spanish translation corrections thanks to Peronia
- Added Norwegian translation thanks to Simen_Cement
- Added Korean translation thanks to Sandball

Thanks for your great feedback!

The full game will come in October, and you can wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570210/Eden_Crafters/

notes.title: Update 0.22
notes.content:
Hi Crafters!

Thanks a lot to everyone of you who played Ocean World: Eden Crafters and provided great feedback and ideas!
Today's update implements some features suggested by the community and fixes some bugs.

Here is the full changelog:
- Warehouses now have more slots, with one line of slots reserved for each conveyor entries.
- New item: Sign with editable text.
- Better identification of what you're dismantling.
- In Co-op mode, you can now enter a vehicle as a passenger (4 people max in the Spaceship)
- Re-worked machines collision. You can now climb on top of a Part Producer or a Greenhouse without fear of getting stuck inside ;)
- Added a Brightness settings
- Fixed water pipes network bugs
- Fixed a bug making ground disappear in some cases of heavy reshaping
- Added Ukrainian translation
- Added Azerbaijan translation

Thank you for your support and don't forget to join our Discord or post in the Steam community forums!

notes.title: Minor Update 0.21b
notes.content:
Hi Crafters!

Today's patch implements some features suggested by the community and fixes some bugs:
- Warehouse now reserves 3 slots for each conveyor entry, for a total of 15 reserved slots. The additionnal slots are available for the first conveyor which filled up its 3 slots.
- New item: Exterior Lamp
- When you dismantle something which contains other items (a chest or a vehicle) you'll receive the content in your inventory.
- The day duration is longer and the night a bit shorter
- Added Turkish translation thanks to Archura Localization
- Improved spaceship controls
- Fixed a bug with spaceship leading to FPS drop
- Fixed misc. bugs

Thanks for your great feedback!

notes.title: Ocean World: Eden Crafters is now available!
notes.content:
Hi Crafters!

We're excited to announce that the Ocean World: Eden Crafters is now available!

If you already tried the demo during Steam Next Fest, this free prologue offers more:
- new terraforming vehicle
- new buildings (including some warehouses: When you build something, the necessary items will be taken first from those stored in a warehouse.)
- an exciting way to prevent the giant waves from happening
- you can now raise the oxygen percent in atmosphere to the point that you don't need oxygen tanks anymore
- and more!

Please note that the game is still in development and Ocean World: Eden Crafters will receive a few updates in the coming weeks, there's still more to be added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890006/0ea277ae8230926047e5a9fba1ad394044006b9b.jpg[/img]

And if you want to continue your journey and terraform some other, very different planets, with tons of new vehicles, buildings and machines, wishlist the upcoming full game Eden Crafters now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570210/Eden_Crafters/

Thank you for your support and don't forget to join our Discord or post in the Steam community forums!
